assignment: Individual full editorial and accuracy review of When a Path Becomes a Cage, including all five runtime case studies.
instructions_read: CANON.md, relevant scope and writing requirements
workflow: Direct research and five editorial passes. The historical write-post and deep-research skills referenced by CANON were unavailable. The prior interrupted review's findings were treated as leads and consequential claims checked independently.

counts.method: HTMLParser text extraction, decoding entities and excluding script, style, SVG and noscript content. Word regex: \b\w+(?:['’-]\w+)*\b. Static counts include headings, chapter links, captions, figure text, inline citation labels and controls. Hero and main are also reported separately. Runtime counts evaluate window.CULTS in Node, strip HTML, and count each case's one, promise, leader, caged, cost and end fields once. They exclude case names, aliases, family labels, repeated controller labels, navigation and comparison-table repetitions.
counts.read_time_basis: Ceiling of the 1181-word static essay and hero divided by 220 words per minute. The hero says 6 min essay because the five optional case cards add another 1152 narrative words; reading the whole essay and every card is about 11 minutes at that rate.

review_judgment.before: The essay imposed an unsupported universal four-stage recruitment story on five distinct groups. It substituted theatrical language for evidence, treated exit cost as a sufficient test, and compressed allegations, religious doctrine, court findings and homicide into one explanatory mechanism. The runtime cases repeated the same errors and contained unsupported figures and mistaken scopes.
review_judgment.after: Rebuilt around DOS collateral and documented forms of pressure. The five cases now identify the particular conduct, authority and evidence available. Legal outcomes accompany allegations; group doctrine is attributed; individual uncertainty remains visible. The comparison preserves useful parallels without equating a demanding course or unusual theology with homicide.
review_judgment.length_judgment: Shortened the static essay substantially while retaining all five independently rewritten cases, the eight Lifton themes, the APA and Barker dispute, and practical questions. The reduction removes repeated trap metaphors, mockery, a redundant BITE card set, several recaps and a self-quotation. Length follows the distinct evidence rather than a preset word target.

factual_corrections.before: Nobody joins a cult; everyone is loved into one; the same four stages explain all five groups.
factual_corrections.after: Removed the universal recruitment and progression claims. The figure now compares four documented kinds of pressure with locally identified evidence and different severity.

factual_corrections.before: A full checklist establishes the diagnosis, and high exit cost is the sharpest single test.
factual_corrections.after: Removed both tests. Cost can arise from poverty, migration or voluntary commitment. The article asks about threats, deception, withheld documents, retaliation and restrictions, and does not assign a numerical or clinical diagnosis.

factual_corrections.before: Lifton's themes described what every total environment does; BITE was presented as a parts list for identifying cults.
factual_corrections.after: Restored the Chinese thought-reform context and the descriptive purpose of Lifton's eight themes. BITE is identified as an advocacy framework, not a validated clinical diagnostic instrument. Lifton's insistence on individual judgment and opposition to coercive deprogramming are included.

factual_corrections.before: The APA rejection and Barker findings were compressed into a broad dismissal of brainwashing across groups.
factual_corrections.after: The 1987 board memorandum rejected the DIMPAC report and declined a broader position. Barker's reported numbers are scoped to more than a thousand attendees at London-area residential workshops in 1979, rather than every group or recruitment setting.

factual_corrections.before: Scientology was reduced to exotic cosmology, unsupported costs above $250000, a sales figure, and categorical family-disconnection claims.
factual_corrections.after: Removed the unsupported prices, sales and mockery. Distinguished church doctrine, the Sea Org pledge, the Headley record, the church's denial and the court's rejection of the forced labor claims. The factual background is not treated as a finding of liability. The Los Angeles church opening in 1954 is identified without an unqualified first-church claim.

factual_corrections.before: The NXIVM course business and DOS were narrated as one uniform participant experience, including unnecessary recruitment estimates and secondary sentencing details.
factual_corrections.after: Separated paid workshops from DOS and its false women-only recruitment premise. Threats involving collateral, trial conduct, Daniela's confinement, the 2019 verdict and the 2020 120-year sentence are grounded in DOJ accounts following conviction. No claim applies that experience to every course attendee.

factual_corrections.before: The Rajneesh case said ten salad bars, gave 1985 as the mass-poisoning outcome in the table, and blurred responsibility for the attack with Rajneesh's deportation.
factual_corrections.after: The attack occurred in 1984. The JAMA investigation identifies 751 ill people and ten definitely implicated restaurants, eight with salad bars. Sheela's management and poisoning plea are distinguished from Rajneesh's spiritual authority and separate immigration plea. The text does not infer that he ordered the attack. The victims outside the commune are not treated as evidence of every resident's exit experience.

factual_corrections.before: 918 members were said to die in the jungle; 304 children was repeated without scope; many adult injections or gunpoint deaths were asserted; the drink brand was used as a rhetorical correction.
factual_corrections.after: Separated 909 deaths at Jonestown, five at the airstrip and four in Georgetown, for 918 overall, including people outside Peoples Temple. Omitted the exact child total because published totals use different scopes and age thresholds. Child poisoning remains murder; adult agreement, fear and direct force cannot be sorted for every person from the surviving evidence. Removed the drink-brand claim and unsupported adult-force quantification.

factual_corrections.before: Jones' motives for the airstrip attack and the universal psychological meaning of Jonestown's restrictions were asserted.
factual_corrections.after: The case attributes guards, work and permission requirements to Layton's pre-death affidavit, describes the Ryan visit and attack through the House staff report, and does not pretend to know the precise motive or decision of every participant.

factual_corrections.before: Heaven's Gate was described as gentle and essentially free of force; belief was said to do all the work of guards; the website was supposedly maintained by two members away that night.
factual_corrections.after: Removed the unsupported characterizations and caretaker story. Group publications establish the stated spiritual consequences and body doctrine. The case leaves each person's conviction, dependency and group pressure uncertain, distinguishes those claims from blackmail or confinement, and uses the Sheriff for 39 deaths discovered on March 26, 1997 over several days. The group's homepage itself says a visible comet companion was irrelevant.

factual_corrections.before: The preserved drive-by photograph was labeled CC BY-SA, with additional wording suggesting a Creative Commons attribution license.
factual_corrections.after: Commons' file-specific record identifies an attribution-only permission. Preserved the image and Samvado Gunnar Kossatz credit; corrected the license description to used with attribution.

voice_passes.name: Monotone read
voice_passes.result: Removed crescendo passages, the recurring machine and cage slogans, the ray metaphor, spaceship mockery and the closing self-quotation. Case openings now name conduct and outcomes that remain meaningful without performance.

voice_passes.name: Delete first paragraph
voice_passes.result: Replaced the historical throat-clearing opener with DOS collateral. The final opening earns its place because deleting it loses the concealed authority, initial disclosures and threatened release needed to understand the next paragraph's concrete coercion. Checked the five card offers for necessary context rather than generic introductions.

voice_passes.name: Generic-sentence test
voice_passes.result: Cut claims about universal longing, loving recruitment and the reader's vulnerability that could be transplanted to any spiritual topic. Replaced the warning-sign diagnosis with questions about information, specific terms, refusal and outside resources. Framework descriptions remain because they explain the named concepts, with scope and limits.

voice_passes.name: Cut ten percent
voice_passes.result: Retained snapshots of the first complete static and runtime rewrite, then removed redundant explanations and repeated verdicts. The combined hero, main and five narratives fell from 2636 to 2333 words, an 11.5 percent cut. Excluding the unchanged final hero, main plus runtime fell from 2592 to 2289, an 11.7 percent cut.

voice_passes.name: Source pass
voice_passes.result: Checked legal outcomes against the full Headley opinion and DOJ conviction and sentencing accounts; outbreak numbers against the complete JAMA paper; Jonestown events against primary affidavits, the House staff report, Q042 and the AFIP letter; and Heaven's Gate doctrine against its own publications, with the Sheriff for the deaths. Checked the sole prose quotation word for word. Source types and the limits of inference are stated beside the claims.

quotations.speaker: Christine Miller
quotations.source_location: Miller's argument with Jones about the children's right to live in the November 18 Project Q042 transcript
quotations.verification: Exact wording checked in the updated transcript. No longer quotation or unverified recollection retained.

uncertainties: No single uniform recruitment process is established across the five cases.
Joining sincerely does not settle whether a later act involved free consent, but demanding commitment or costly departure alone does not establish coercion.
BITE and Lifton are descriptive aids here, not clinical diagnoses or numerical thresholds.
The Headley statutory forced labor claims failed; the opinion does not settle every possible legal theory or every member's experience.
DOJ accounts establish the conviction and described trial conduct, not a uniform experience for all NXIVM attendees.
Rajneesh's immigration plea does not prove that he ordered the salmonella contamination.
Published Jonestown child counts differ by scope and age threshold; no exact count is asserted.
The Jonestown recording and limited autopsies cannot assign unforced agreement, fear or direct compulsion to every adult death.
Heaven's Gate publications establish spiritual claims. The part played by personal conviction, dependency and group pressure remains uncertain for each individual.
Current organizational publications establish continued activity, not membership size, efficacy or the truth of doctrine.
suggested_hub_description: Five cases of spiritual authority, threats and restricted choice, with court records, testimony and the groups' own words.
